clone.comment: allow clone(any of {CLONE_VM, CLONE_FS, CLONE_FILES, CLONE_SIGHAND, CLONE_VFORK, CLONE_THREAD, CLONE_SYSVSEM, CLONE_SETTLS, CLONE_PARENT_SETTID, CLONE_CHILD_CLEARTID, CLONE_DETACHED, CLONE_CHILD_SETTID}, *, *, *, *) (from include/uapi/linux/sched.h)

setsockopt.comment: allow setsockopt(*, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_NODELAY, *, *) (from include/uapi/linux/in.h and include/uapi/linux/tcp.h)
allow setsockopt(*, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_V6ONLY, *, *) (from include/uapi/linux/in.h and include/uapi/linux/in6.h)

socket.comment: allow socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM | any of {SOCK_CLOEXEC, SOCK_NONBLOCK, SOCK_COREDUMP}, *) (from include/linux/socket.h and include/linux/net.h)
allow socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_DGRAM | any of {SOCK_CLOEXEC, SOCK_NONBLOCK, SOCK_COREDUMP}, *) (from include/linux/socket.h and include/linux/net.h)
allow socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM | any of {SOCK_CLOEXEC, SOCK_NONBLOCK, SOCK_COREDUMP}, *) (from include/linux/socket.h and include/linux/net.h)
allow socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM | any of {SOCK_CLOEXEC, SOCK_NONBLOCK, SOCK_COREDUMP}, *) (from include/linux/socket.h and include/linux/net.h)
allow socket(AF_INET6, SOCK_STREAM | any of {SOCK_CLOEXEC, SOCK_NONBLOCK, SOCK_COREDUMP}, *) (from include/linux/socket.h and include/linux/net.h)
allow socket(AF_INET6, SOCK_DGRAM | any of {SOCK_CLOEXEC, SOCK_NONBLOCK, SOCK_COREDUMP}, *) (from include/linux/socket.h and include/linux/net.h)

socketpair.comment: allow socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM | any of {SOCK_CLOEXEC, SOCK_NONBLOCK, SOCK_COREDUMP}, *) (from include/linux/socket.h and include/linux/net.h)
allow socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_DGRAM | any of {SOCK_CLOEXEC, SOCK_NONBLOCK, SOCK_COREDUMP}, *) (from include/linux/socket.h and include/linux/net.h)

fcntl.comment: allow fcntl(*, one of {F_DUPFD, F_GETFD, F_SETFD, F_GETFL, F_SETFL, F_GETLK, F_SETLK, F_SETLKW}, ...) (from include/uapi/asm-generic/fcntl.h)

futex.comment: allow futex(*, FUTEX_WAIT | any of {FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, FUTEX_CLOCK_REALTIME, FUTEX_ROBUST_UNLOCK, FUTEX_ROBUST_LIST32}, ...) (from include/uapi/linux/futex.h)
allow futex(*, FUTEX_WAKE | any of {FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, FUTEX_CLOCK_REALTIME, FUTEX_ROBUST_UNLOCK, FUTEX_ROBUST_LIST32}, ...) (from include/uapi/linux/futex.h)
allow futex(*, FUTEX_WAIT_BITSET | any of {FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, FUTEX_CLOCK_REALTIME, FUTEX_ROBUST_UNLOCK, FUTEX_ROBUST_LIST32}, ...) (from include/uapi/linux/futex.h)
allow futex(*, FUTEX_WAKE_BITSET | any of {FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, FUTEX_CLOCK_REALTIME, FUTEX_ROBUST_UNLOCK, FUTEX_ROBUST_LIST32}, ...) (from include/uapi/linux/futex.h)

mmap.comment: allow mmap(*, *, *, any of {MAP_SHARED, MAP_PRIVATE, MAP_DROPPABLE, MAP_FIXED, MAP_ANONYMOUS, MAP_DENYWRITE, MAP_NORESERVE, MAP_STACK}, *, *) (from include/uapi/linux/mman.h, include/uapi/asm-generic/mman.h, and include/uapi/asm-generic/mman-common.h)
